mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, password, name, email, role, provider, provider_user_id, profile_image FROM member WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( login_id, password, name, email, role, provider, provider_user_id, profile_image ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{role}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{profileImage} )
